instructions: Path A over the 17-question benchmark. single_hop rows must PASS (test_baseline_succeeds); multi_hop and long_distance rows are expected to FAIL (test_baseline_fails). A passing multi_hop row means the corpus is not hard enough — see corpus/manifest.yaml negatives.

cases.question: What is the shelf life of the Classic Sourdough?
Which product was withdrawn under W-2025-014?
Which flour supplier for the withdrawn product also supplies the High Street bakery?
Which product did recipe change RC-88 apply to, and what is that product's shelf life?
Why was the Classic Sourdough launch delayed?
cases.expected_fact: a rejected batch (4471), oven 3 reallocated for six weeks, the flour change to Heritage Stoneground flour, and the allergen retest it forced
cases.competing_answer: launch_plan_sourdough.pdf — top hit, shows the dates moving, explains nothing

cases.question: Is there a recurring quality problem at the High Street bakery?
cases.expected_fact: Yes — four separate incidents of underweight loaves at the High Street bakery across 2025 (February, May, August and October), each recorded by a different function and none referring to any other.
cases.competing_answer: the "High Street site quality overview" section of facilities_site_services.pdf — a near-perfect lexical match that reports no incidents

cases.question: What temperature is the deck oven set to for the Classic Sourdough?
cases.expected_fact: 230 °C, with steam for the first 10 minutes and a core temperature check after 35 minutes

cases.question: What is the baked weight tolerance for the Classic Sourdough?
cases.expected_fact: 10 g at Class A, 20 g at Class B, 30 g at Class C

cases.question: What flour is currently specified for the Classic Sourdough?
What approval level is required for a documentation-only change?
Which bakery had the most waste in 2025, and was the trend improving?
cases.expected_fact: Station Road bakery, with 2311 loaves wasted, and yes — waste fell across the year

cases.question: How many recipe changes were raised, and how many of them required Level 3 approval?
cases.expected_fact: 8 recipe changes; 2 of them (RC-88 and RC-95) required Level 3

cases.question: Did waste at the High Street bakery fall after the baking procedure was revised?
cases.expected_fact: Yes — about 189 loaves a month before RC-91 and about 159 a month after
